question: Which of the following organisations was founded by Surendranath Banerjee and Ananda Mohan Bose in 1876?
solution:
The Correct answer is **__The Indian Association__**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Indian Association** was the first Indian nationalist organization founded in the period of British India by Mr Surendranath Banerjee and Ananda Mohan Bose in the year **1876. **
 
• The Main objectives of this Association were to "promote by every legitimate means the political, intellectual and material advancement of the Indian people".
 
• The association was supported mainly by younger professional men among the Bengali Intellectuals.
 
• It spread over Bengal to other parts of India but still remained Bengali in character, using refugee Bengali communities as centres for its Non-Urban branches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Poona Sarvajanik Sabha was formed in the year **1867 by Ganesh Vasudeo Joshi.**
 
• **Radhakanta deb **Established British Indian Association in the year **1851.**
